name: Peralta & Alameda Creek Trail
description: Foot patrol along the north and south banks of Alameda Creek. Focus on delivering hot breakfast burritos, fresh water, heavy tarps, and checking on seniors living in dome tents.

name: Warm Springs Vehicle Dwellers
target: Cars, RVs, and vans in commuter park-and-rides
description: Mobile outreach serving unhoused workers and families living in vehicles around South Fremont industrial streets. Provides gas vouchers, vehicle oil top-offs, dry pantry boxes, and hygiene kits.

name: Centerville Train Station Corridor
description: Evening hospitality walk around historic Centerville. Distribution of warm soup, clean blankets, and hygiene bags.

name: Cedar & Thornton Industrial Perimeter
target: Industrial cul-de-sacs and car camping zones
description: Outreach to long-term vehicle residents along the salt marsh industrial edge. Checking in on safety, providing clean drinking water, dog food for companion animals, and trash disposal bags.

name: Newark Blvd Motel Corridor
target: Families and individuals in transient weekly motels
description: Delivering fresh groceries, milk, fruit, and children's school supplies directly to weekly motel rooms. Supporting mothers with housing navigation referrals and prayer support.

name: Decoto Rail Spur & 11th Street
target: Rail easements, converted vans, and wooded pockets
description: Close-knit outreach group walking the historic rail line and surrounding wooded easements. Building multi-month relationships with long-term unhoused neighbors.

name: Alvarado-Niles Transit Buffer
target: Bus depots, park benches, and commercial buffers
description: Evening presence connecting with folks waiting near public transit hubs. Distributing warm cider, socks, and Alameda County resource pamphlets.

name: Mission Blvd & A Street Corridor
target: Sidewalk camps, alleyways, and motel steps
description: Active walking route in downtown Hayward. Engaging folks along Mission Blvd with hearty bagged lunches, fresh underwear/socks, and connecting with South Hayward Parish shelter programs.

name: San Lorenzo Creek Greenway
target: Dry creek beds, bridge overpasses, and willow groves
description: Pancake breakfast hospitality table set up beneath the Foothill Blvd bridge. A safe, welcoming morning space for prayer, hot food, and community fellowship.

name: Industrial Blvd Parking Buffer
description: Checking in on vehicle residents parked along long warehouse curbs. Fire extinguisher safety checks, battery charging help, and care packages.
